Mixed columns bound row oscillation via DB>=2(m-1)osc(r), and mixed rows bound column oscillation via DA>=2(n-1)osc(c). All-positive signs attain baseline in the sharp parameter rectangle. One entire sign-flipped row/column gives strict quantified excess outside. Actual script verifies 49 rational cases and independent vertex enumeration; finite checks are corroboration only. No boundary or quantifier omissions.

value.rationale: The exactly characterized two-dimensional parameter stability rectangle is a natural metric invariant of the canonical simplex shuffle of two generalized permutohedra. Sharp thresholds differ in each coordinate according to the opposite block size, and the mixed-sign deficit inequalities characterize why the antipodal zonotope endpoints remain globally extremal. The natural unit-weight shuffle is an immediate useful specialization and the supercritical explicit witnesses show real structural change. This is an all-size geometric classification, not a table lookup or routine reparameterization, and no unsupported broader applications are claimed.
